massEmpty.sourceNote: Wikipedia's infobox figure, with the detachable machete buttstock attached, carries no inline citation of its own; matched exactly by the secondary reference site modernfirearms.net, which also states 1.6 kg with the buttstock removed.

length.sourceNote: With the buttstock attached, per modernfirearms.net; the same source gives 360 mm with the buttstock removed. Wikipedia's own infobox states no length.

barrelLength.sourceNote: Per modernfirearms.net, which does not distinguish the shotgun and rifle barrel lengths. Wikipedia's own infobox states no barrel length.

capacity.sourceNote: The lower barrel is a single-shot break-open rifle chamber; no magazine is fitted.

images.alt: A dark, blued triple-barrelled pistol with a wooden grip and no buttstock attached, displayed in a museum case beside an ammunition bandolier and its canvas machete sheath.
images.caption: A TP-82 without its detachable machete buttstock, on display at the Military Historical Museum of Artillery, Engineers and Signal Corps in Saint Petersburg, alongside its ammunition bandolier.
